summary: When Nora is tagged under an Instagram post and writes an answer without sending it, she is now asked once, in the same turn, whether to post it.
details: Only a reply she then sends herself is posted; the unsent text is never posted on its own, and if she still does not send, the summons stays silent as before.
The follow-up happens at most once per summons, uses the same tools and the same limits as the turn it continues, and shows in the same trace.
Each follow-up is counted in nora_summons_follow_ups_total by what it ended in (replied or silent) and logged with the summons id.
limitations: The summons ledger row does not record whether a follow-up happened; the metric and the log line do.
